verdict.rationale: A sandbox or test environment is a fair question for an analytics SaaS, but the pack documents no GA4-provided sandbox or test property that keeps tests away from production data. The "BigQuery sandbox" is a free BigQuery tier used as an export destination, which is a host-platform feature rather than a GA4 test environment. Query Explorer lets you test queries interactively, but nothing shows it runs against isolated data rather than live property data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
